title: Recovering when a shared plan changes
challenge: A mixed team has six weeks and a modest, reversible experiment budget to improve what happens when a shared plan changes unexpectedly. They have several anecdotes but no direct observations, no validated primary user, and no agreement whether the problem is noticing the change, interpreting it, coordinating a response, or knowing who owns the next action. A shared digital dashboard has been proposed, but no build decision has been made.
task: Give your current position, what you notice first, the uncertainty you would protect, and one concrete next move.
evidence_status: The challenge statement and existence of anecdotes are USER_PROVIDED for this exercise.
No anecdote contents, direct observations, interviews, or validated user are available.
The dashboard is a proposed solution, not evidence of the problem.
